query.name: Cross-Database Query Tests
query.description: MongoDB pipeline to Oracle SQL translation validation

tests.name: Equality match - string
tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "SALES"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q1" q WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.status.stringOnly() == $B0)' PASSING 'completed' AS "B0" TYPE(strict))), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", KEEP '$."_id"', '$."orderId"', '$."status"') FROM "Q2" q) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q3"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "SALES"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q1" q
   WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.status.stringOnly() == $B0)' PASSING 'completed' AS "B0" TYPE(STRICT))),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA", KEEP '$."_id"', '$."orderId"', '$."status"')
   FROM "Q2" q)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q3"

tests.name: Group with count
tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "SALES"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA".status, 'count' VALUE SUM(1)) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q1") q GROUP BY q."DATA".status), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q2") q ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA"."_id" DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) ASC NULLS LAST, q."DATA"."_id" ASC NULLS LAST) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q3"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "SALES"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA".status, 'count' VALUE SUM(1)) AS "DATA"

   FROM

SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)

tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "EMPLOYEES"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."deptUpper"' = UPPER(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.department'))) FROM "Q1" q), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA".deptUpper, 'avgSalary' VALUE AVG(q."DATA".salary), 'headcount' VALUE SUM(1)) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q2") q GROUP BY q."DATA".deptUpper), "Q4" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q3") q ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA"."_id" DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) ASC NULLS LAST, q."DATA"."_id" ASC NULLS LAST) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q4"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "EMPLOYEES"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."deptUpper"' = UPPER(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.department')))
   FROM "Q1" q),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA".deptUpper, 'avgSalary' VALUE AVG(q."DATA".salary), 'headcount' VALUE SUM(1)) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q2") q
   GROUP BY q."DATA".deptUpper),
     "Q4" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q3") q
   ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA"."_id" DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) ASC NULLS LAST, q."DATA"."_id" ASC NULLS LAST)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q4"

tests.name: Basic $unionWith - two collections
tests.description: Tests $unionWith to combine employees and customers (names from both)

tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "EMPLOYEES"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS

                         SET '$."source"' = 'employee', KEEP '$."_id"', '$."name"', '$."source"')

tests.name: Basic $bucket - price ranges
tests.description: Tests $bucket to group products by price ranges (no default needed - all values covered)
tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "PRODUCTS"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE CASE WHEN q."DATA".price >= 0 AND q."DATA".price < 25 THEN 0 WHEN q."DATA".price >= 25 AND q."DATA".price < 100 THEN 25 WHEN q."DATA".price >= 100 AND q."DATA".price < 1000 THEN 100 END, 'count' VALUE SUM(1), 'products' VALUE JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.name') RETURNING JSON)) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q1") q GROUP BY CASE WHEN q."DATA".price >= 0 AND q."DATA".price < 25 THEN 0 WHEN q."DATA".price >= 25 AND q."DATA".price < 100 THEN 25 WHEN q."DATA".price >= 100 AND q."DATA".price < 1000 THEN 100 END), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q2") q ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA"."_id" DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) ASC NULLS LAST, q."DATA"."_id" ASC NULLS LAST) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q3"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "PRODUCTS"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE CASE
                                      WHEN q."DATA".price >= 0
                                           AND q."DATA".price < 25 THEN 0
                                      WHEN q."DATA".price >= 25
                                           AND q."DATA".price < 100 THEN 25
                                      WHEN q."DATA".price >= 100
                                           AND q."DATA".price < 1000 THEN 100
                                  END, 'count' VALUE SUM(1), 'products' VALUE JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.name') RETURNING JSON)) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q1") q
   GROUP BY CASE
                WHEN q."DATA".price >= 0
                     AND q."DATA".price < 25 THEN 0
                WHEN q."DATA".price >= 25
                     AND q."DATA".price < 100 THEN 25
                WHEN q."DATA".price >= 100
                     AND q."DATA".price < 1000 THEN 100
            END),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q2") q
   ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA"."_id" DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) ASC NULLS LAST, q."DATA"."_id" ASC NULLS LAST)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q3"

tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "EMPLOYEES"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE CASE WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 60000 AND q."DATA".salary < 75000 THEN 60000 WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 75000 AND q."DATA".salary < 90000 THEN 75000 WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 90000 AND q."DATA".salary < 110000 THEN 90000 END, 'count' VALUE SUM(1), 'avgBonus' VALUE AVG(q."DATA".bonus)) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q1") q GROUP BY CASE WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 60000 AND q."DATA".salary < 75000 THEN 60000 WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 75000 AND q."DATA".salary < 90000 THEN 75000 WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 90000 AND q."DATA".salary < 110000 THEN 90000 END), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q2") q ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA"."_id" DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) ASC NULLS LAST, q."DATA"."_id" ASC NULLS LAST) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q3"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "EMPLOYEES"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE CASE
                                      WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 60000
                                           AND q."DATA".salary < 75000 THEN 60000
                                      WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 75000
                                           AND q."DATA".salary < 90000 THEN 75000
                                      WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 90000

SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)

tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "PRODUCTS"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q1" q WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.active.booleanOnly() == $B0)' PASSING true AS "B0" TYPE(strict))), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('min' VALUE MIN(group_val), 'max' VALUE MAX(group_val)), 'count' VALUE SUM(1), 'avgPrice' VALUE AVG(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.price'))) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY q."DATA".price) AS bucket_id, q."DATA".price AS group_val, "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q2") q) GROUP BY bucket_id ORDER BY bucket_id) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q3"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "PRODUCTS"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q1" q
   WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.active.booleanOnly() == $B0)' PASSING TRUE AS "B0" TYPE(STRICT))),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('min' VALUE MIN(group_val), 'max' VALUE MAX(group_val)), 'count' VALUE SUM(1), 'avgPrice' VALUE AVG(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.price'))) AS "DATA"

tests.sqlFormatted:

   FROM

                                                                                                                                                   (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON)
                                                                                                                                                    FROM "Q2_topEarners"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON)), 'totalStats' VALUE COALESCE(
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       FROM "Q2_totalStats"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON))) AS "DATA"
   FROM DUAL)

tests.name: $type - get field type
tests.description: Tests $type operator to get BSON type of a field
tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "SALES"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."statusType"' = CASE WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.status') IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.status' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) IS NOT NULL AND MOD(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.status' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR), 1) = 0 THEN 'int' WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.status' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) IS NOT NULL THEN 'double' WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.status') IN ('true', 'false') THEN 'bool' ELSE 'string' END, SET '$."amountType"' = CASE WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.amount') IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.amount' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) IS NOT NULL AND MOD(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.amount' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR), 1) = 0 THEN 'int' WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.amount' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) IS NOT NULL THEN 'double' WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.amount') IN ('true', 'false') THEN 'bool' ELSE 'string' END, KEEP '$."_id"', '$."statusType"', '$."amountType"') FROM "Q1" q), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q2" q FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY), "Q4" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q3") q ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA"."_id" DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) ASC NULLS LAST, q."DATA"."_id" ASC NULLS LAST) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q4"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "SALES"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."statusType"' = CASE
                                                    WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.status') IS NULL THEN 'null'
                                                    WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.status' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) IS NOT NULL
                                                         AND MOD(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.status' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR), 1) = 0 THEN 'int'
                                                    WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.status' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) IS NOT NULL THEN 'double'
                                                    WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.status') IN ('true', 'false') THEN 'bool'
                                                    ELSE 'string'
                                                END,
                         SET '$."amountType"' = CASE
                                                    WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.amount') IS NULL THEN 'null'
                                                    WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.amount' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) IS NOT NULL
                                                         AND MOD(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.amount' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR), 1) = 0 THEN 'int'
                                                    WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.amount' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) IS NOT NULL THEN 'double'
                                                    WHEN JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.amount') IN ('true', 'false') THEN 'bool'
                                                    ELSE 'string'
                                                END, KEEP '$."_id"', '$."statusType"', '$."amountType"')
   FROM "Q1" q),

   FROM "Q2" q FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY),

tests.name: $facet - pagination with offset
tests.description: Tests $facet pagination with $skip offset for page 2. Groups orders and returns count with offset data.
tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "PURCHASE_ORDERS"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q1" q WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.locationNumber.stringOnly() == $B0)' PASSING 'LOC001' AS "B0" TYPE(strict))), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('docRefNumber' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.docRefNumber'), 'customerPONumber' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.customerPONumber'))) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q2") q GROUP BY JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.docRefNumber'), JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.customerPONumber')), "Q4_recordCount" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('count' VALUE COUNT(*)) AS "DATA" FROM "Q3" q), "Q4_data" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q3" q OFFSET 3 ROWS FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY), "Q4" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('recordCount' VALUE COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON) FROM "Q4_recordCount"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON)), 'data' VALUE COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON) FROM "Q4_data"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON))) AS "DATA" FROM DUAL), "Q5" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."totalRecords"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.recordCount.count[0]'), SET '$."pageData"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.data[*]._id' WITH WRAPPER), KEEP '$."totalRecords"', '$."pageData"') FROM "Q4" q) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q5"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "PURCHASE_ORDERS"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q1" q
   WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.locationNumber.stringOnly() == $B0)' PASSING 'LOC001' AS "B0" TYPE(STRICT))),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('docRefNumber' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.docRefNumber'), 'customerPONumber' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.customerPONumber'))) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q2") q
   GROUP BY JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.docRefNumber'),
            JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.customerPONumber')),
     "Q4_recordCount" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('count' VALUE COUNT(*)) AS "DATA"
   FROM "Q3" q),
     "Q4_data" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q3" q
   OFFSET 3 ROWS FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY),
     "Q4" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('recordCount' VALUE COALESCE(
                                                     (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON)
                                                      FROM "Q4_recordCount"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON)), 'data' VALUE COALESCE(
                                                                                                                                   (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON)
                                                                                                                                    FROM "Q4_data"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON))) AS "DATA"
   FROM DUAL),
     "Q5" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."totalRecords"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.recordCount.count[0]'),
                         SET '$."pageData"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.data[*]._id' WITH WRAPPER), KEEP '$."totalRecords"', '$."pageData"')
   FROM "Q4" q)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q5"

tests.name: $facet - sorted pagination with aggregation
tests.description: Tests $facet pagination with sorting and aggregation in the data branch. Includes $sum accumulator in group stage.
tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "PURCHASE_ORDERS"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q1" q WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.status.stringOnly() in ($B0, $B1))' PASSING 'completed' AS "B0", 'shipped' AS "B1" TYPE(strict))), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA".locationNumber, 'totalAmount' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".amount), 'orderCount' VALUE SUM(1)) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q2") q GROUP BY q."DATA".locationNumber), "Q4_summary" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('count' VALUE COUNT(*)) AS "DATA" FROM "Q3" q), "Q4_results" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q3" q ORDER BY JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.totalAmount' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.totalAmount') DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY), "Q4" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('summary' VALUE COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON) FROM "Q4_summary"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON)), 'results' VALUE COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON) FROM "Q4_results"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON))) AS "DATA" FROM DUAL), "Q5" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."locationCount"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.summary.count[0]'), SET '$."topLocations"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.results'), KEEP '$."locationCount"', '$."topLocations"') FROM "Q4" q) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q5"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "PURCHASE_ORDERS"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q1" q
   WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.status.stringOnly() in ($B0, $B1))' PASSING 'completed' AS "B0", 'shipped' AS "B1" TYPE(STRICT))),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA".locationNumber, 'totalAmount' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".amount), 'orderCount' VALUE SUM(1)) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q2") q
   GROUP BY q."DATA".locationNumber),
     "Q4_summary" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('count' VALUE COUNT(*)) AS "DATA"
   FROM "Q3" q),
     "Q4_results" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q3" q
   ORDER BY JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.totalAmount' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.totalAmount') DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY),
     "Q4" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('summary' VALUE COALESCE(
                                                 (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON)
                                                  FROM "Q4_summary"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON)), 'results' VALUE COALESCE(
                                                                                                                              (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON)
                                                                                                                               FROM "Q4_results"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON))) AS "DATA"
   FROM DUAL),
     "Q5" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."locationCount"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.summary.count[0]'),
                         SET '$."topLocations"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.results'), KEEP '$."locationCount"', '$."topLocations"')
   FROM "Q4" q)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q5"

tests.name: Customer order count and total spent
tests.description: Calculate customer metrics by joining orders_detailed
tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "CUSTOMERS"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA", SET '$."orders"' = COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(f."DATA" RETURNING JSON) FROM "ORDERS_DETAILED" f WHERE f."DATA".customerId = q."DATA"."_id"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON))) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q1") q), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."orderCount"' = JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.orders.size()' RETURNING NUMBER), SET '$."totalSpent"' = (SELECT NVL(SUM(TO_NUMBER(val)), 0) FROM JSON_TABLE("DATA", '$.orders[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.payment.amount'))), KEEP '$."_id"', '$."name"', '$."tier"', '$."orderCount"', '$."totalSpent"') FROM "Q2" q) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q3"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "CUSTOMERS"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA",
                         SET '$."orders"' = COALESCE(
                                                       (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(f."DATA" RETURNING JSON)
                                                        FROM "ORDERS_DETAILED" f
                                                        WHERE f."DATA".customerId = q."DATA"."_id"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON))) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q1") q),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."orderCount"' = JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.orders.size()' RETURNING NUMBER),
                         SET '$."totalSpent"' =
                           (SELECT NVL(SUM(TO_NUMBER(val)), 0)
                            FROM JSON_TABLE("DATA", '$.orders[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.payment.amount'))), KEEP '$."_id"', '$."name"', '$."tier"', '$."orderCount"', '$."totalSpent"')
   FROM "Q2" q)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q3"

tests.name: Revenue by product category from line items
tests.description: Unwind line items and aggregate by category
tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "ORDERS_DETAILED"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q1" q WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.status.stringOnly() in ($B0, $B1))' PASSING 'delivered' AS "B0", 'shipped' AS "B1" TYPE(strict))), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA", SET '$."lineItems"' = jt.elem) AS "DATA" FROM "Q2" q, JSON_TABLE(q."DATA", '$.lineItems[*]' COLUMNS (elem JSON PATH '$')) jt), "Q4" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA".lineItems.category, 'revenue' VALUE SUM((JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.lineItems.quantity' RETURNING NUMBER) * JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.lineItems.unitPrice' RETURNING NUMBER))), 'itemCount' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".lineItems.quantity)) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q3") q GROUP BY q."DATA".lineItems.category), "Q5" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q4") q ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA".revenue DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, q."DATA".revenue DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q5"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "ORDERS_DETAILED"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q1" q
   WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.status.stringOnly() in ($B0, $B1))' PASSING 'delivered' AS "B0", 'shipped' AS "B1" TYPE(STRICT))),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA",
                         SET '$."lineItems"' = jt.elem) AS "DATA"
   FROM "Q2" q,
        JSON_TABLE(q."DATA", '$.lineItems[*]' COLUMNS (elem JSON PATH '$')) jt),
     "Q4" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA".lineItems.category, 'revenue' VALUE SUM((JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.lineItems.quantity' RETURNING NUMBER) * JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.lineItems.unitPrice' RETURNING NUMBER))), 'itemCount' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".lineItems.quantity)) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q3") q
   GROUP BY q."DATA".lineItems.category),
     "Q5" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q4") q
   ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA".revenue DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, q."DATA".revenue DESC NULLS LAST)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q5"

tests.name: Running total by category
tests.description: Calculate running sum within category partition
tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "SALES"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q1" q WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.status.stringOnly() == $B0)' PASSING 'completed' AS "B0" TYPE(strict))), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA", SET '$."runningTotal"' = SUM(JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.amount' RETURNING NUMBER)) OVER (PARTITION BY JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.category') ORDER BY JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.orderDate' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) ASC NULLS LAST, JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.orderDate') ASC NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS "DATA" FROM "Q2" q), "Q4" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", KEEP '$."_id"', '$."category"', '$."orderDate"', '$."amount"', '$."runningTotal"') FROM "Q3" q) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q4"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "SALES"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q1" q
   WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.status.stringOnly() == $B0)' PASSING 'completed' AS "B0" TYPE(STRICT))),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA",
                         SET '$."runningTotal"' = SUM(JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.amount' RETURNING NUMBER)) OVER (PARTITION BY JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.category')
                                                                                                               ORDER BY JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.orderDate' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) ASC NULLS LAST, JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.orderDate') ASC NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS "DATA"

FROM "Q4"

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 FROM (JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.resolvedAt' RETURNING TIMESTAMP) - JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.createdAt' RETURNING TIMESTAMP))) * 60000 + EXTRACT(SECOND
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          FROM (JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.resolvedAt' RETURNING TIMESTAMP) - JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.createdAt' RETURNING TIMESTAMP))) * 1000)
                                                                                                        END / 3600000)
                                                             ELSE NULL

WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "EMPLOYEES"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q1" q
   WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?((@.reportsTo == null || !(exists(@.reportsTo))))')),
     "graph_paths_directAndIndirectReports" (start_id,
                                             id,
                                             connect_from_val,
                                             DATA,
                                             graph_depth) AS
  (SELECT s."DATA"."_id" AS start_id,
          g."DATA"."_id" AS id,
          g."DATA"."_id" AS connect_from_val,
          g."DATA" AS DATA,
          0 AS graph_depth
   FROM "EMPLOYEES" g,

     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q2") s
   WHERE g."DATA".reportsTo = s."DATA"."_id"
   UNION ALL SELECT p.start_id,
                    c."DATA"."_id" AS id,
                    c."DATA"."_id" AS connect_from_val,
                    c."DATA" AS DATA,
                    p.graph_depth + 1 AS graph_depth
   FROM "EMPLOYEES" c
   JOIN "graph_paths_directAndIndirectReports" p ON c."DATA".reportsTo = p.connect_from_val
   WHERE p.graph_depth < 5),
     "graph_directAndIndirectReports" AS
  (SELECT start_id,
          JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_MERGEPATCH(DATA, JSON_OBJECT('level' VALUE graph_depth)) RETURNING CLOB) AS "directAndIndirectReports"
   FROM "graph_paths_directAndIndirectReports"
   GROUP BY start_id),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform(s."DATA",
                         SET '$."directAndIndirectReports"' = COALESCE(g."directAndIndirectReports", JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING CLOB))) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q2") s
   LEFT JOIN "graph_directAndIndirectReports" g ON s."DATA"."_id" = g.start_id),
     "Q4" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."teamSize"' = JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.directAndIndirectReports.size()' RETURNING NUMBER),
                         SET '$."totalTeamSalary"' =
                           (SELECT NVL(SUM(TO_NUMBER(val)), 0)
                            FROM JSON_TABLE("DATA", '$.directAndIndirectReports[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.salary'))),
                         SET '$."totalTeamBonus"' =
                           (SELECT NVL(SUM(TO_NUMBER(val)), 0)
                            FROM JSON_TABLE("DATA", '$.directAndIndirectReports[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.bonus'))),
                         SET '$."avgTeamRating"' =
                           (SELECT AVG(TO_NUMBER(val))
                            FROM JSON_TABLE("DATA", '$.directAndIndirectReports[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.rating'))))
   FROM "Q3" q),
     "Q5" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."totalTeamCompensation"' = (JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.totalTeamSalary' RETURNING NUMBER) + JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.totalTeamBonus' RETURNING NUMBER)),
                         SET '$."avgTeamRating"' = ROUND(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.avgTeamRating' RETURNING NUMBER), 2), KEEP '$."_id"', '$."name"', '$."department"', '$."salary"', '$."teamSize"', '$."totalTeamSalary"', '$."totalTeamBonus"', '$."totalTeamCompensation"', '$."avgTeamRating"')
   FROM "Q4" q)

tests.name: Page View Session Analysis

tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "PAGE_VIEWS"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA".sessionId, 'userId' VALUE MIN(q."DATA".userId), 'pageCount' VALUE SUM(1), 'totalDuration' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".duration), 'hasConversion' VALUE MAX(CASE WHEN q."DATA".isConversion = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 'deviceType' VALUE MIN(q."DATA".device.type), 'browser' VALUE MIN(q."DATA".device.browser), 'firstPage' VALUE MIN(q."DATA".page), 'lastPage' VALUE MAX(q."DATA".page), 'sessionStart' VALUE MIN(q."DATA".timestamp), 'sessionEnd' VALUE MAX(q."DATA".timestamp), 'totalEvents' VALUE SUM(JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.events.size()' RETURNING NUMBER))) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q1") q GROUP BY q."DATA".sessionId), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."avgPageDuration"' = CASE WHEN q."DATA".pageCount > 0 THEN (JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.totalDuration' RETURNING NUMBER) / JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.pageCount' RETURNING NUMBER)) ELSE 0 END, SET '$."isAuthenticated"' = CASE WHEN q."DATA".userId IS NOT NULL THEN JSON('true') ELSE JSON('false') END) FROM "Q2" q), "Q4" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."sessionId"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$._id'), SET '$."avgPageDuration"' = ROUND(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.avgPageDuration' RETURNING NUMBER), 0), SET '$."hasConversion"' = CASE WHEN q."DATA".hasConversion = 1 THEN true ELSE false END, KEEP '$."userId"', '$."isAuthenticated"', '$."pageCount"', '$."totalDuration"', '$."deviceType"', '$."browser"', '$."firstPage"', '$."lastPage"', '$."totalEvents"', '$."sessionId"', '$."avgPageDuration"', '$."hasConversion"') FROM "Q3" q), "Q5" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q4") q ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA".totalDuration DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, q."DATA".totalDuration DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q5"

WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "PAGE_VIEWS"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA".sessionId, 'userId' VALUE MIN(q."DATA".userId), 'pageCount' VALUE SUM(1), 'totalDuration' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".duration), 'hasConversion' VALUE MAX(CASE
                                                                                                                                                                                                 WHEN q."DATA".isConversion = TRUE THEN 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                 ELSE 0
                                                                                                                                                                                             END), 'deviceType' VALUE MIN(q."DATA".device.type), 'browser' VALUE MIN(q."DATA".device.browser), 'firstPage' VALUE MIN(q."DATA".page), 'lastPage' VALUE MAX(q."DATA".page), 'sessionStart' VALUE MIN(q."DATA".timestamp), 'sessionEnd' VALUE MAX(q."DATA".timestamp), 'totalEvents' VALUE SUM(JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.events.size()' RETURNING NUMBER))) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q1") q
   GROUP BY q."DATA".sessionId),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."avgPageDuration"' = CASE
                                                         WHEN q."DATA".pageCount > 0 THEN (JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.totalDuration' RETURNING NUMBER) / JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.pageCount' RETURNING NUMBER))
                                                         ELSE 0
                                                     END,
                         SET '$."isAuthenticated"' = CASE
                                                         WHEN q."DATA".userId IS NOT NULL THEN JSON('true')
                                                         ELSE JSON('false')
                                                     END)
   FROM "Q2" q),
     "Q4" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."sessionId"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$._id'),
                         SET '$."avgPageDuration"' = ROUND(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.avgPageDuration' RETURNING NUMBER), 0),
                         SET '$."hasConversion"' = CASE
                                                       WHEN q."DATA".hasConversion = 1 THEN TRUE
                                                       ELSE FALSE
                                                   END, KEEP '$."userId"', '$."isAuthenticated"', '$."pageCount"', '$."totalDuration"', '$."deviceType"', '$."browser"', '$."firstPage"', '$."lastPage"', '$."totalEvents"', '$."sessionId"', '$."avgPageDuration"', '$."hasConversion"')
   FROM "Q3" q),
     "Q5" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q4") q
   ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA".totalDuration DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, q."DATA".totalDuration DESC NULLS LAST)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q5"

WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "SALES"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q1" q
   WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.status.stringOnly() == $B0)' PASSING 'completed' AS "B0" TYPE(STRICT))),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA".region, 'totalSales' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".amount), 'orderCount' VALUE SUM(1), 'avgOrderValue' VALUE AVG(q."DATA".amount), 'totalQuantity' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".quantity), 'totalDiscount' VALUE SUM(NVL(CAST(q."DATA".discount AS NUMBER), 0))) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q2") q
   GROUP BY q."DATA".region),
     "Q4" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA",
                         SET '$."salesRank"' = RANK() OVER (
                                                            ORDER BY JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.totalSales' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.totalSales') DESC NULLS LAST),
                         SET '$."denseRank"' = DENSE_RANK() OVER (
                                                                  ORDER BY JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.totalSales' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.totalSales') DESC NULLS LAST),
                         SET '$."percentOfTotal"' = SUM(JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.totalSales' RETURNING NUMBER)) OVER (
                                                                                                                     ORDER BY JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.totalSales' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.totalSales') DESC NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)) AS "DATA"
   FROM "Q3" q),
     "Q5" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."salesPercentage"' = ((JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.totalSales' RETURNING NUMBER) / JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.percentOfTotal' RETURNING NUMBER)) * 100))
   FROM "Q4" q),
     "Q6" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."region"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$._id'),
                         SET '$."totalSales"' = ROUND(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.totalSales' RETURNING NUMBER), 2),
                         SET '$."avgOrderValue"' = ROUND(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.avgOrderValue' RETURNING NUMBER), 2),
                         SET '$."salesPercentage"' = ROUND(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.salesPercentage' RETURNING NUMBER), 1), KEEP '$."orderCount"', '$."salesRank"', '$."region"', '$."totalSales"', '$."avgOrderValue"', '$."salesPercentage"')
   FROM "Q5" q),
     "Q7" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q6") q
   ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA".salesRank DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) ASC NULLS LAST, q."DATA".salesRank ASC NULLS LAST)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q7"

tests.name: Sales with Array Transformations
tests.description: Complex array transformations using $map, $filter, and $reduce on order items
tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "SALES"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q1" q WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?((exists(@.items) && exists(@.items[0])))')), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."itemCount"' = JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.items.size()' RETURNING NUMBER), SET '$."itemsWithTotal"' = (SELECT COALESCE(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('product' VALUE product, 'qty' VALUE qty, 'price' VALUE price, 'lineTotal' VALUE (qty * price))), JSON_ARRAY()) FROM JSON_TABLE("DATA", '$.items[*]' COLUMNS (product PATH '$.product', qty NUMBER PATH '$.qty', price NUMBER PATH '$.price'))), SET '$."highValueItems"' = (SELECT COALESCE(JSON_ARRAYAGG(val FORMAT JSON), JSON_ARRAY()) FROM JSON_TABLE("DATA", '$.items[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR2(4000) FORMAT JSON PATH '$', qty NUMBER PATH '$.qty', price NUMBER PATH '$.price')) WHERE (qty * price) >= 100), SET '$."calculatedTotal"' = (SELECT NVL(SUM((qty * price)), 0) FROM JSON_TABLE("DATA", '$.items[*]' COLUMNS (qty NUMBER PATH '$.qty', price NUMBER PATH '$.price')))) FROM "Q2" q), "Q4" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."highValueCount"' = JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.highValueItems.size()' RETURNING NUMBER), SET '$."avgItemPrice"' = CASE WHEN q."DATA".itemCount > 0 THEN (JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.calculatedTotal' RETURNING NUMBER) / JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.itemCount' RETURNING NUMBER)) ELSE 0 END) FROM "Q3" q), "Q5" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."avgItemPrice"' = ROUND(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.avgItemPrice' RETURNING NUMBER), 2), KEEP '$."_id"', '$."orderId"', '$."customerName"', '$."itemCount"', '$."calculatedTotal"', '$."highValueCount"', '$."itemsWithTotal"', '$."avgItemPrice"') FROM "Q4" q), "Q6" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q5") q ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA".calculatedTotal DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, q."DATA".calculatedTotal DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q6"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "SALES"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q1" q
   WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?((exists(@.items) && exists(@.items[0])))')),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."itemCount"' = JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.items.size()' RETURNING NUMBER),
                         SET '$."itemsWithTotal"' =
                           (SELECT COALESCE(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('product' VALUE product, 'qty' VALUE qty, 'price' VALUE price, 'lineTotal' VALUE (qty * price))), JSON_ARRAY())
                            FROM JSON_TABLE("DATA", '$.items[*]' COLUMNS (product PATH '$.product', qty NUMBER PATH '$.qty', price NUMBER PATH '$.price'))),
                         SET '$."highValueItems"' =
                           (SELECT COALESCE(JSON_ARRAYAGG(val FORMAT JSON), JSON_ARRAY())
                            FROM JSON_TABLE("DATA", '$.items[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR2(4000) FORMAT JSON PATH '$', qty NUMBER PATH '$.qty', price NUMBER PATH '$.price'))
                            WHERE (qty * price) >= 100),
                         SET '$."calculatedTotal"' =
                           (SELECT NVL(SUM((qty * price)), 0)
                            FROM JSON_TABLE("DATA", '$.items[*]' COLUMNS (qty NUMBER PATH '$.qty', price NUMBER PATH '$.price'))))
   FROM "Q2" q),
     "Q4" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."highValueCount"' = JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.highValueItems.size()' RETURNING NUMBER),
                         SET '$."avgItemPrice"' = CASE
                                                      WHEN q."DATA".itemCount > 0 THEN (JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.calculatedTotal' RETURNING NUMBER) / JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.itemCount' RETURNING NUMBER))
                                                      ELSE 0
                                                  END)
   FROM "Q3" q),
     "Q5" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."avgItemPrice"' = ROUND(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.avgItemPrice' RETURNING NUMBER), 2), KEEP '$."_id"', '$."orderId"', '$."customerName"', '$."itemCount"', '$."calculatedTotal"', '$."highValueCount"', '$."itemsWithTotal"', '$."avgItemPrice"')
   FROM "Q4" q),
     "Q6" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q5") q
   ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA".calculatedTotal DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, q."DATA".calculatedTotal DESC NULLS LAST)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q6"

WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "ORDERS"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA",
                         SET '$."items"' = jt.elem) AS "DATA"
   FROM "Q1" q,
        JSON_TABLE(q."DATA", '$.items[*]' COLUMNS (elem JSON PATH '$')) jt),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA",
                         SET '$."productInfo"' = COALESCE(
                                                            (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(f."DATA" RETURNING JSON)
                                                             FROM "PRODUCTS" f
                                                             WHERE f."DATA"."_id" = q."DATA".items.productId), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON))) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q2") q),
     "Q4" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA",
                         SET '$."productInfo"' = jt.elem) AS "DATA"
   FROM "Q3" q,
        JSON_TABLE(q."DATA", '$.productInfo[*]' COLUMNS (elem JSON PATH '$')) jt),
     "Q5" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('category' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.productInfo.category'), 'productId' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.productInfo._id'), 'productName' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.productInfo.name')), 'totalQuantitySold' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".items.quantity), 'totalRevenue' VALUE SUM((JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.items.quantity' RETURNING NUMBER) * JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.productInfo.price' RETURNING NUMBER)))) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q4") q
   GROUP BY JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.productInfo.category'),
            JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.productInfo._id'),
            JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.productInfo.name')),
     "Q6" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA"."_id".category, 'totalCategoryRevenue' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".totalRevenue), 'products' VALUE JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('productId' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$._id.productId'), 'productName' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$._id.productName'), 'totalQuantitySold' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.totalQuantitySold'), 'totalRevenue' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.totalRevenue')) RETURNING JSON)) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q5") q
   GROUP BY q."DATA"."_id".category),
     "Q7" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."category"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$._id'),
                         SET '$."topProducts"' =
                           (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(val FORMAT JSON
                                                 ORDER BY rn)
                            FROM
                              (SELECT val, rn
                               FROM JSON_TABLE(
                                                 (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(val FORMAT JSON
                                                                       ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC)
                                                  FROM JSON_TABLE(JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.products'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR2(4000) FORMAT JSON PATH '$', totalRevenue NUMBER PATH '$.totalRevenue'))), '$[*]' COLUMNS (val VARCHAR2(4000) FORMAT JSON PATH '$', rn
                                                                                                                                                                                                                           FOR
                                                                                                                                                                                                                           ORDINALITY)) FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY)), KEEP '$."totalCategoryRevenue"', '$."category"', '$."topProducts"')
   FROM "Q6" q)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q7"

tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "ORDERS"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q1" q
   WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(exists(@.items[1]))')),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA",
                         SET '$."items"' = jt.elem) AS "DATA"
   FROM "Q2" q,
        JSON_TABLE(q."DATA", '$.items[*]' COLUMNS (elem JSON PATH '$')) jt),
     "Q4" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA"."_id", 'products' VALUE JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.items.productId') RETURNING JSON), 'productCount' VALUE SUM(1), 'totalQty' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".items.quantity)) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q3") q
   GROUP BY q."DATA"."_id"),
     "Q5" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q4" q
   WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.productCount.numberOnly() >= $B0)' PASSING 2 AS "B0" TYPE(STRICT))),
     "Q6" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA",
                         SET '$."products"' = jt.elem) AS "DATA"
   FROM "Q5" q,
        JSON_TABLE(q."DATA", '$.products[*]' COLUMNS (elem JSON PATH '$')) jt),
     "Q7" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE q."DATA".products, 'coOrderCount' VALUE SUM(1), 'totalQuantityOrdered' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".totalQty)) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q6") q
   GROUP BY q."DATA".products),
     "Q8" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA",
                         SET '$."productInfo"' = COALESCE(
                                                            (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(f."DATA" RETURNING JSON)
                                                             FROM "PRODUCTS" f
                                                             WHERE f."DATA"."_id" = q."DATA"."_id"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON))) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q7") q),
     "Q9" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform(q."DATA",
                         SET '$."productInfo"' = jt.elem) AS "DATA"
   FROM "Q8" q,
        JSON_TABLE(q."DATA", '$.productInfo[*]' COLUMNS (elem JSON PATH '$')) jt),
     "Q10" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."productId"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$._id'),
                         SET '$."productName"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.productInfo.name'),
                         SET '$."category"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.productInfo.category'), KEEP '$."coOrderCount"', '$."totalQuantityOrdered"', '$."productId"', '$."productName"', '$."category"')
   FROM "Q9" q),
     "Q11" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q10") q
   ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA".coOrderCount DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, q."DATA".coOrderCount DESC NULLS LAST,
                                                                                               TO_NUMBER(q."DATA".productId DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) ASC NULLS LAST, q."DATA".productId ASC NULLS LAST)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q11"

tests.name: Paginated Search with Facet Metadata
tests.description: Pagination pattern using $facet to return both metadata (total count) and paginated data
tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "PRODUCTS"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q1" q WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.active.booleanOnly() == $B0)' PASSING true AS "B0" TYPE(strict))), "Q3_metadata" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('totalCount' VALUE COUNT(*)) AS "DATA" FROM "Q2" q), "Q3_data" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$._id'), 'name' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.name'), 'category' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.category'), 'price' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.price'), 'stock' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.stock')) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q2" q ORDER BY JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.price' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.price') DESC NULLS LAST OFFSET 2 ROWS FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY)), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('metadata' VALUE COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON) FROM "Q3_metadata"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON)), 'data' VALUE COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON) FROM "Q3_data"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON))) AS "DATA" FROM DUAL), "Q4" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."metadata"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.metadata[0]')) FROM "Q3" q), "Q5" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."totalCount"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.metadata[*].totalCount' WITH WRAPPER), SET '$."page"' = 2, SET '$."pageSize"' = 3, SET '$."totalPages"' = CEIL((JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.metadata.totalCount' RETURNING NUMBER) / 3))) FROM "Q4" q), "Q6" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", KEEP '$."totalCount"', '$."page"', '$."pageSize"', '$."totalPages"', '$."data"') FROM "Q5" q) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q6"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "PRODUCTS"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM "Q1" q
   WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.active.booleanOnly() == $B0)' PASSING TRUE AS "B0" TYPE(STRICT))),
     "Q3_metadata" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('totalCount' VALUE COUNT(*)) AS "DATA"
   FROM "Q2" q),
     "Q3_data" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$._id'), 'name' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.name'), 'category' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.category'), 'price' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.price'), 'stock' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.stock')) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT "DATA"
      FROM "Q2" q
      ORDER BY JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.price' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, JSON_VALUE(q."DATA", '$.price') DESC NULLS LAST
      OFFSET 2 ROWS FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY)),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('metadata' VALUE COALESCE(
                                                  (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON)
                                                   FROM "Q3_metadata"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON)), 'data' VALUE COALESCE(
                                                                                                                             (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING JSON)
                                                                                                                              FROM "Q3_data"), JSON_ARRAY(RETURNING JSON))) AS "DATA"
   FROM DUAL),
     "Q4" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."metadata"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.metadata[0]'))
   FROM "Q3" q),
     "Q5" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."totalCount"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.metadata[*].totalCount' WITH WRAPPER),
                         SET '$."page"' = 2,
                         SET '$."pageSize"' = 3,
                         SET '$."totalPages"' = CEIL((JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.metadata.totalCount' RETURNING NUMBER) / 3)))
   FROM "Q4" q),
     "Q6" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA", KEEP '$."totalCount"', '$."page"', '$."pageSize"', '$."totalPages"', '$."data"')
   FROM "Q5" q)
SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB)
FROM "Q6"

tests.name: Employee Salary Analysis with Bucket and Window Functions
tests.description: Bucket employees by salary ranges and compute ranking within each bucket
tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "EMPLOYEES"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE CASE WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 0 AND q."DATA".salary < 70000 THEN '0' WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 70000 AND q."DATA".salary < 85000 THEN '70000' WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 85000 AND q."DATA".salary < 100000 THEN '85000' WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 100000 AND q."DATA".salary < 200000 THEN '100000' ELSE 'Other' END, 'count' VALUE SUM(1), 'employees' VALUE JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('name' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.name'), 'department' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.department'), 'salary' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.salary')) RETURNING JSON), 'avgSalary' VALUE AVG(q."DATA".salary), 'totalBonus' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".bonus)) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q1") q GROUP BY CASE WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 0 AND q."DATA".salary < 70000 THEN '0' WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 70000 AND q."DATA".salary < 85000 THEN '70000' WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 85000 AND q."DATA".salary < 100000 THEN '85000' WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 100000 AND q."DATA".salary < 200000 THEN '100000' ELSE 'Other' END), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."salaryRange"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$._id'), SET '$."avgSalary"' = ROUND(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.avgSalary' RETURNING NUMBER), 0), KEEP '$."count"', '$."totalBonus"', '$."employees"', '$."salaryRange"', '$."avgSalary"') FROM "Q2" q), "Q4" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q3") q ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA".salaryRange DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) ASC NULLS LAST, q."DATA".salaryRange ASC NULLS LAST) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q4"
tests.sqlFormatted:
WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "EMPLOYEES"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE CASE
                                      WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 0
                                           AND q."DATA".salary < 70000 THEN '0'
                                      WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 70000
                                           AND q."DATA".salary < 85000 THEN '70000'
                                      WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 85000
                                           AND q."DATA".salary < 100000 THEN '85000'
                                      WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 100000
                                           AND q."DATA".salary < 200000 THEN '100000'
                                      ELSE 'Other'
                                  END, 'count' VALUE SUM(1), 'employees' VALUE JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('name' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.name'), 'department' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.department'), 'salary' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.salary')) RETURNING JSON), 'avgSalary' VALUE AVG(q."DATA".salary), 'totalBonus' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".bonus)) AS "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q1") q
   GROUP BY CASE
                WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 0
                     AND q."DATA".salary < 70000 THEN '0'
                WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 70000
                     AND q."DATA".salary < 85000 THEN '70000'
                WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 85000
                     AND q."DATA".salary < 100000 THEN '85000'
                WHEN q."DATA".salary >= 100000
                     AND q."DATA".salary < 200000 THEN '100000'
                ELSE 'Other'
            END),
     "Q3" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT json_transform("DATA",
                         SET '$."salaryRange"' = JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$._id'),
                         SET '$."avgSalary"' = ROUND(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.avgSalary' RETURNING NUMBER), 0), KEEP '$."count"', '$."totalBonus"', '$."employees"', '$."salaryRange"', '$."avgSalary"')
   FROM "Q2" q),
     "Q4" ("DATA") AS
  (SELECT "DATA"
   FROM
     (SELECT *

tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "ECOMMERCE_ORDERS"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM "Q1" q WHERE JSON_EXISTS("DATA", '$?(@.status.stringOnly() in ($B0, $B1))' PASSING 'delivered' AS "B0", 'shipped' AS "B1" TYPE(strict))), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('status' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.status'), 'month' VALUE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.timestamps.createdAt'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"')), 'year' VALUE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.timestamps.createdAt'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"'))), 'totalRevenue' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".pricing.subtotal), 'orderCount' VALUE SUM(1), 'avgShipping' VALUE AVG(q."DATA".pricing.shipping), 'avgTax' VALUE AVG(q."DATA".pricing.tax)) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q2") q GROUP BY JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.status'), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.timestamps.createdAt'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"')), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.timestamps.createdAt'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"'))), "Q4" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."avgRevenuePerOrder"' = ROUND((JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.totalRevenue' RETURNING NUMBER) / JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.orderCount' RETURNING NUMBER)), 2)) FROM "Q3" q), "Q5" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q4") q ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA".totalRevenue DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, q."DATA".totalRevenue DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q5"

           "DATA") AS
  (SELECT "ID",
          "DATA"
   FROM "ECOMMERCE_ORDERS"),
     "Q2" ("DATA") AS

   FROM "Q1" q

     "Q3" ("DATA") AS

                                                                                                                   FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.timestamps.createdAt'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"')), 'year' VALUE EXTRACT(YEAR

   FROM
     (SELECT *
      FROM "Q2") q
   GROUP BY JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.status'),
            EXTRACT(MONTH

WITH "Q1" ("ID",

tests.name: Order Analysis by Payment and Shipping Method

tests.sql: WITH "Q1" ("ID", "DATA") AS (SELECT "ID", "DATA" FROM "ECOMMERCE_ORDERS"), "Q2" ("DATA") AS (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('_id' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('paymentMethod' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.payment.method'), 'shippingMethod' VALUE JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.shipping.method')), 'orderCount' VALUE SUM(1), 'totalRevenue' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".pricing.subtotal), 'totalShipping' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".pricing.shipping), 'totalTax' VALUE SUM(q."DATA".pricing.tax), 'avgOrderValue' VALUE AVG(q."DATA".pricing.subtotal), 'maxOrderValue' VALUE MAX(q."DATA".pricing.subtotal), 'minOrderValue' VALUE MIN(q."DATA".pricing.subtotal)) AS "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q1") q GROUP BY JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.payment.method'), JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.shipping.method')), "Q3" ("DATA") AS (SELECT json_transform("DATA", SET '$."avgRevenuePerOrder"' = ROUND((JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.totalRevenue' RETURNING NUMBER) / JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.orderCount' RETURNING NUMBER)), 2), SET '$."shippingPercent"' = ROUND(CASE WHEN q."DATA".totalRevenue > 0 THEN ((JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.totalShipping' RETURNING NUMBER) / JSON_VALUE("DATA", '$.totalRevenue' RETURNING NUMBER)) * 100) ELSE 0 END, 1)) FROM "Q2" q), "Q4" ("DATA") AS (SELECT "DATA" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Q3") q ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(q."DATA".totalRevenue DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) DESC NULLS LAST, q."DATA".totalRevenue DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG("DATA" RETURNING CLOB) FROM "Q4"

WITH "Q1" ("ID",
           "DATA") AS

          "DATA"
   FROM "ECOMMERCE_ORDERS"),
